admission_rule: Every visitor-facing video or animation is admitted occurrence by occurrence. Narrated media is judged against the words spoken at that moment; silent media is judged against its learning, interface or narrative purpose. Sampling, file playback and measured pixel movement cannot produce a complete PASS.
